results.name: Starts on bag aura; exactly 320 by 64 and click-through normally
Three actual stack events reset the minute and completion fades once
Countdown never awards fabricated stacks when the server has not granted them
Leaving stops progression; reentry resets the partial minute, keeping real stacks
Three existing stacks show refresh countdown until the real expiration increases
Existing buff outside the bag does not show a timer or completion popup
Combat hides and clears the countdown without reading restricted auras
Unavailable, secret containers and secret counts are never used or formatted
Malformed stack counts are rejected; unrelated legacy talent does not qualify
Preview lasts 15 seconds, is draggable, and does not change real state
Actual resting takes precedence over preview
Position is persisted, invalid position is handled, reset only clears this position
Saved false preference is respected; on and off apply immediately
World entry restarts an estimated minute and ignores target/secret unit aura events
Settings support late load and register a single category

scope: Production Lua 5.1; simulated aura state, events, clock and UI; no live WoW claim
